summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the TradeKonekt Activity Simulator (super-admin Console / Simulator tab). 10/10 backend pytest cases passed against the live preview URL. All frontend critical flows passed via Playwright: super-admin console renders with both Impersonate + Simulator tabs, the simulator panel mounts with the 4 KPI cards, seed-demo tagged 385 participants, force tick incremented Last tick to '14s ago', the Medium level became Active, the toggle switch works without errors, the purge dialog opens and confirming purges all generated docs (toast: '20 docs deleted across 9 collections'), and the Impersonate regression works — clicking impersonate-unilever@tradekonekt.io lands on /dashboard as the Unilever manufacturer.

issues: Status KPI badge briefly shows 'Paused' immediately after a toggle-off→toggle-on round trip because the panel polls /admin/simulator only every 15s. Backend confirms running=True within 2s. Minor UX nit only — consider an optimistic update or shorter post-action poll.

critical_code_review_comments: services/simulator.py: get_settings() returns the doc *before* its update_one runs the persistence flow; OK for now but if total_ticks/total_events update_one fails partway, settings may drift from in-memory counters. Consider atomic $inc instead of read-then-write.
services/simulator.py: trigger_one_tick() reaches into runtime._tick(settings) (private member access). Expose a public method to avoid accidental refactor breakage.

routes/admin_simulator.py: simulator_status() iterates 9 collections sequentially with count_documents per request. With Atlas latency this is ~9 round-trips per 15s poll per admin. Consider asyncio.gather() to parallelise.
SuperAdminSimulator.jsx (677 lines): borderline file-size — fine for now but if Recent Runs grows, extract into a child component.

Status KPI uses (running && enabled ? 'Running' : enabled ? 'Starting…' : 'Paused'). After a toggle ON the badge can sit on 'Starting…' for up to 15s until the next poll lands; OK but consider optimistic update.
seed_data_creation: Called POST /api/admin/simulator/participants/seed-demo via UI and pytest — tags 385 demo entities across Unilever + Flour Mills tenants. Idempotent; rerunning leaves the total unchanged. After tests, the suite re-seeds participants so the panel stays populated for the next agent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_simulator.py is the canonical regression suite for the simulator endpoints. It exercises status, seed-demo idempotency, toggle on/off, level change, force tick (asserts total_ticks increments and events_generated > 0), purge (asserts counts back to 0 and total_deleted = sum(deleted)), participants clear, and 403 for manufacturer. The Playwright UI checks rely on these data-testids: super-admin-console, tab-impersonate, tab-simulator, super-admin-simulator, sim-status-badge, sim-total-events, sim-tick-btn, sim-seed-btn, sim-level-{low,medium,high}, sim-enabled-switch, sim-purge-btn, sim-purge-dialog, sim-purge-confirm, sim-participants-list, sim-runs-table, impersonate-<email>. Note: the runtime running flag may flip to false right after a uvicorn hot-reload — call toggle(true) to resume (already covered by test_toggle_off_on).
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. The 'Paused' badge after toggle is a 15s polling-lag display nit, not a functional bug.
